## Problem

What are you trying to do that the current tools don't support? Prefer a
concrete use case over an abstract one.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see added or changed. If it maps to an existing concept
in the codebase (a new `TrajectoryAnalyzer`, a new `scripts/` entry point,
a new `processes/` step), say so.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.

## Additional context

Links to relevant papers, related issues, or example output.
